description: Get the current understanding graph as XML context. For large graphs (50+ nodes), returns a compact view with overview of important concepts and region summaries. Use graph_context_region to drill into specific regions.

compact.description: Force compact mode (region summaries instead of full graph). Auto-enabled for large graphs.

detail_level.description: Control verbosity: "titles" = just node names, "brief" = titles + truncated understanding (100 chars), "full" = everything (default)

hide_document_content.description: Hide content from document nodes but show their structure. Useful for seeing doc outline without full text.

include_fields.description: Granular field selection. Overrides detail_level. Example: ["title", "trigger"] for minimal view

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for output (default: 8000). Lower values show fewer concepts per region.

nodeId.description: Focus context around a specific node and its neighbors. Overrides compact mode.

show_evolution.description: Include superseded nodes to see how understanding evolved

name: graph_context
